overrides.value: the heading's box on the text edge
overrides.instead: text-indent: -0.04em (h2) and -0.05em (the companion's title): the box 1.2 to 1.6 px left of the edge
overrides.reason: Optical alignment. These headings start with a round or pointed Didot capital (A, S, C, T) whose ink sat 1 px inside the ink of the text below at 42 px (ITTEN optical-margin); pulled left by the amount the check advises, the ink passes the edge slightly and looks on it. Headings that start with a straight stem are not moved.

overrides.instead: 1 px borders at the fractional positions layout gives them (Table 1's rule above its notes, on both pages; Plate III's play button; the two copy buttons)
overrides.reason: Not a departure in what the reader sees. The positions follow the fluid type above them, so no fixed value would land on whole pixels at every width. Chromium and WebKit both snap the table rule to whole pixels (the check measured 5 of 5 and 3 of 3 samples crisp), and the copy buttons' borders are one crisp pixel in both engines, zoomed eight times at 1x. The play button is a circle, drawn anti-aliased at any position, which the check cannot profile.

overrides.instead: the same baseline: no departure; the check is skipped on the condition cells
overrides.reason: Table 1's cells are on one baseline (vertical-align: baseline): a zero-size inline-block in each cell of row 1 sits at 9049.516 px in WebKit and 9049.266 px in Chromium at 1040 px. ITTEN 0.3.2 estimates a baseline from the line's rect and the font's ascent and descent as canvas reports them, which WebKit rounds to whole pixels while its rects use the font's own; at 1040 px in WebKit the estimate puts the 14 px condition 0.5 px above the 16.16 px reading. Reported upstream (docs/itten/upstream.md, issue 6). The ignore also leaves these cells' left edges out of the check; they are one table column, so they share that edge by construction.
